subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep pursuing this PR's probe-based exit-0 behavior after v2026.6.11 shipped the systemd exit-78 supervised-lock fix?
rationale: The shipped implementation already addresses the main restart-loop class with a different exit-code contract, while this PR changes startup/auth semantics and has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Confirm Supersession
options.body: Close this branch if exit 78 is the intended contract and track any remaining non-systemd probe gap in a narrower current-main issue.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase that keeps only the remaining probe behavior, fixes trusted-proxy and IPv6 handling, drops release-owned churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept Probe Semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose exit-0 healthy-probe semantics despite the compatibility and auth-boundary tradeoff, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Confirm Supersession
recommendation.body: Close this branch if exit 78 is the intended contract and track any remaining non-systemd probe gap in a narrower current-main issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and release-history evidence make this the clearest owner for the competing shipped gateway lock and trusted-proxy behavior.
